_doc: Sect missions (G-008), taken by sect members via GameState.take_mission. Fields: id, name, description; sects: sect ids that offer it ([] or missing = every sect); min_rank: minimum sect rank index (default 0); min_realm: realm id (default mortal); min_stage: minimum stage index within min_realm (default 0, e.g. 4 = 5th Layer of Qi Refining; higher realms always qualify); kind: gather | hunt | deliver | guard; requires: {items: {item_id: count}} handed in (consumed) on completion; enemy: enemies.json id that must be beaten first (required for hunt and guard; losing fails the mission); days: time the mission takes besides any fight (>= 1); contribution: sect contribution earned (>= 0, may promote); rewards: shared Effects keys (items, qi, alignment, ...); cooldown_days: days after taking it before it can be taken again (default 0).

missions.name: Gather Spirit Herbs
missions.description: The sect's alchemy hall is short of common spirit herbs. Bring five.

missions.name: Dew Grass for the Medicine Hall
missions.description: The Medicine Hall's elders need morning dew grass for their salves. Bring four bundles.

missions.name: Carry Goods to the Market
missions.description: A crate of the Pavilion's wares must be carried down to the village market. Nobody wants to pay a porter.

missions.name: Collect a Debt
missions.description: A bandit owes the Lotus a debt in blood and silver. Persuade him, with fists, to pay.

missions.name: Cull the Mist Wolves
missions.description: A mist wolf has been stalking disciples on the mountain paths. Hunt it down.

missions.name: Deliver Cold Iron
missions.description: The armory needs cold iron for the disciples' blades.

missions.name: Escort Mortal Villagers
missions.description: Guard a column of mortal villagers past a bandit-infested pass.

missions.name: Purge a Demonic Cultivator
missions.description: A demonic cultivator has been draining mortals near the sect. Inner disciples are sent to end him.

missions.name: Harvest a Rogue Cultivator
missions.description: The sect's blood pools need fresh essence. A lone rogue cultivator will do.

missions.name: Blood Ginseng Tithe
missions.description: The Blood Elders demand a tithe of blood ginseng from their disciples.

missions.name: Guard a Pavilion Caravan
missions.description: A Pavilion caravan needs an escort through bandit country.

missions.name: Procure Azure Crystal
missions.description: A Pavilion client wants azure crystal. Find one, and the Pavilion pays you in standing.

missions.name: Patrol the Misty Peaks
missions.description: Walk the outer ridges for a week and turn back whatever beast creeps toward the mortal villages below.

missions.name: Relieve a Fevered Village
missions.description: A fever sweeps a mortal village at the foot of the peaks. Bring salves and spend days tending the sick.

missions.name: Subdue the Stone Ape
missions.description: A stone ape has torn down a village granary twice this season. The Law Enforcement Hall wants it gone.

missions.name: Replenish the Mountain Array
missions.description: The great protective array over the peaks drinks crystal faster than the mines yield it. Bring azure crystal and earth vein jade to the array hall.

missions.name: Slay the Jade-Scaled Python
missions.description: A python with scales like green jade has swallowed a whole caravan. Core disciples are sent before it reaches the villages.

missions.name: Press-Gang a Bandit Gang
missions.description: Break a bandit gang and drag the survivors back in chains. The sect always needs more blood servants.

missions.name: Feed the Blood Pool
missions.description: The blood pool beneath the sect hall must be fed with spirit herbs steeped in fresh blood. Bring herbs; do not ask whose blood.

missions.name: Silence a Talebearer
missions.description: A wandering cultivator has been carrying tales of the sect to the righteous. See that he never arrives.

missions.name: Drain a Stone Ape's Marrow
missions.description: Stone ape marrow tempers a blood disciple's bones. Bring the beast down and drain it alive.

missions.name: Bleed a Cloud Eagle
missions.description: A Blood Elder's furnace needs the heart blood of a cloud eagle, still warm.

missions.name: Thousand-Soul Offering
missions.description: The Blood Sons are to raise a soul banner. Their juniors supply the refined blood pills, and do not ask how many lives went into each.

missions.name: Fill a Herb Order
missions.description: A pill house in the lowlands placed an order for purple cloud mushrooms. The Pavilion keeps its promises on time.

missions.name: Forge Militia Swords
missions.description: A mortal county is arming its militia against beasts. Deliver two iron swords and the Pavilion takes its cut.

missions.name: Recover a Stolen Consignment
missions.description: A rogue cultivator robbed a Pavilion courier. Bring back the goods; the Pavilion does not care how.

missions.name: An Alchemist's Rare Order
missions.description: A Foundation alchemist wants fire and ice in one parcel: two flame lotuses and an ice soul flower.

missions.name: Escort a Star Silver Shipment
missions.description: Cloud eagles have learned that Pavilion airboats carry star silver. Ride along and keep the sky clear.

missions.name: Consign to the Grand Auction
missions.description: The Pavilion's grand auction needs headline lots. Senior stewards who supply star silver share in the glory.

missions.name: Ambush an Azure Cloud Patrol
missions.description: An Azure Cloud enforcer has been hanging Blood Lotus scouts from the city gates. The Blood Sons are sent to show the righteous dogs that the road bites back.

missions.name: Escort the Beast Cages
missions.description: A wagon of caged spirit beasts bound for the Pavilion's menagerie draws an iron-horned rhino out of the hills. Senior stewards ride guard.

missions.name: Seal the Nether Ghost King
missions.description: A ghost king has woken in the old battlefield ruins and drags the living into its tomb. Elders of the Azure Cloud Sect go to seal it before it grows.

missions.name: Purge a Blood Lotus Elder
missions.description: A Blood Lotus elder has been draining whole villages to feed the blood pools. The sect sends its core disciples to end him.

missions.name: Tear Out the Bear King's Heart
missions.description: The heart of a Black Iron Bear King beats for a day after it dies, full of hot blood qi. The blood pools want it fresh.

missions.name: Milk the Myriad Poison Toad
missions.description: The Blood Elders brew their worst poisons from the venom of a Myriad Poison Toad. Someone has to wring it out of the beast alive.

missions.name: Escort the Thunder Roc Feathers
missions.description: A shipment of thunderwing roc feathers for the grand auction calls their owner's mate down from the storm clouds. Pavilion elders guard the convoy themselves.

missions.name: Supply Dragonblood Gold
missions.description: A Nascent Soul patron has ordered a sword forged from dragonblood gold. The Pavilion elder who supplies the metal takes a share of a fortune.
